title: budget controls replace the percentile tier when a config carries a budget
verifies: edit-load flips sensitivity_mode to budget and renders the budget cap control, hiding the percentile tier

title: a budget tier preset fans out into count and period
verifies: each budget preset writes its count and period and lights the clicked tier

title: a sub-1/day stored budget surfaces as alerts per week
verifies: a per-day budget below 1 displays as an equivalent per-week count (0.5/day -> 3.5/week)

title: an invalid budget count blocks save with the budget-range message
verifies: a non-positive budget count paints the sensitivity error and blocks save

title: the budget hint names the cap and is suppressed on invalid input
verifies: the budget hint names the per-day cap and disappears when the count is invalid

title: saving a budget config persists alert_budget_per_day
verifies: the budget save payload persists the per-day cap to the config

title: a config without a budget still renders the percentile tier
verifies: budget mode does not leak into default edits; percentile tier remains with its value

title: an off-tier budget count is accepted with no tier selected
verifies: a non-preset budget count is valid, lights no preset, and shows the hint

title: budget mode still requires a destination when notifications are enabled
verifies: enabling notifications on a budget config without a destination blocks save

title: a per-day budget of exactly 1 stays in day units
verifies: the per-day/week boundary at 1.0 stays in day units
